messages:
gareth: Quick sync on a new idea: allow inline edit of the reviewer rationale in compact rows (single-line edit) so the 'why' is captured before approve. Keeps density but surfaces reason. Thoughts?
mina: Love that. If it's single-line editable, we need a clear affordance so people don't think it's static text. Maybe a faint pencil icon + focus outline on hover/focus.
lex: Keyboard-first: Tab into the rationale pill, type to edit, Enter to save draft, Cmd/Ctrl+Enter to approve. That prevents accidental approves.
rachel: For bulk-approve, we should let people apply a shared rationale or per-item edits. UX: show a small toolbar when multiple selected: [Apply to all] [Edit per-item] [Confirm approval].
gareth: Microcopy candidates for the edit placeholder: A) "Add a short reason (optional)" B) "Why accept? e.g. brevity" C) "Reviewer note". Which is clearer at small sizes?
mina: Prefer A for clarity. Also show the saved snippet as "Reason: brevity" in compact mode (no label when space is tiny).
lex: Accessibility: if the inline edit exists, it must expose aria-label like `Edit reviewer note for diff {id}` and announce save: `Note saved for diff {id}` in a polite live region.
a11y-bot: Accessibility checklist:
- Inline edit should be a real <textarea> or input with aria-label and aria-live announcements for save/validation.
- Approve action should be guarded: Enter saves edit; Cmd/Ctrl+Enter triggers confirm. Announce confirmation: `Approval confirmed for {n} items. Reviewer note: {summary}` via role="status" (polite).
- For bulk-apply, when applying a shared note announce: `Applied note to {n} items` and return focus to the selection toolbar.
rachel: Undo flow: show 8s snackbar: `Approved 5 items. Note preview: "{first 60 chars}" [Undo]`. If undone, announce `Approval undone for {n} items`.
gareth: Small visual idea: darker weight for reviewer text vs model score in compact rows. That nudges human intent to read first.
mina: Edge case: what if someone types long note in compact edit? Truncate visually but keep full text in modal and SR reads full text on request with a `Show full note` button.
lex: Dev proposal: prototype in storybook with keyboard only. I'll map keys: Enter -> save edit; Ctrl+Enter -> approve; Esc -> cancel edit.
a11y-bot: Suggested announcement strings for PRD:
- On approve: `Approval confirmed for {n} items. Reviewer note: {summary}`
- On save note: `Reviewer note saved for diff {id}`
- On apply to all: `Reviewer note applied to {n} items`
gareth: Action items: Lex -> prototype keyboard + storybook, Mina -> microcopy variants and icon treatment, Rachel -> bulk toolbar mock + snackbar wording, a11y -> validate announcement strings. I'll collect prototypes for quick hallway test. Thanks! :sparkles:
